verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a CLI that can retrieve secrets in scripts and CI/CD, plus member permissions on shared vaults. Neither documents issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials (e.g., service-account or vault-scoped tokens) that an agent could use. Vault-sharing permissions and CLI secret injection are adjacent features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
